en.description:
Stay ahead in the intergalactic battle for democracy with the War Monitor for Helldivers 2 companion app, now featuring the addictive Stratagem Hero mini-game! Get real-time updates on the ongoing war, track planet statuses and liberation levels, and view the current Major Order all at your fingertips. Challenge your Stratagem skills and climb the ranks on the Game Center leaderboards. Enhance your Helldivers 2 experience with strategic insights and up-to-the-minute information, ensuring you're always ready for your next mission. Download the Helldivers Companion app War Monitor and do your part!

Features:

- Completely FREE with NO ADS! 
- Live updates on the Helldivers 2 intergalactic war
- Planet status and Major Order monitoring, view history of liberation, defense and player count with beautiful charts!
- GALAXY MAP! Plan and strategise your next moves, featuring supply lines!
- SUPER STORE ROTATION! Check the currently available items in the Super Store
- Armours Weapons, Stratagems and Boosters glossary to check the stats for all the equipment you might need out on the field!
- View details for each planet showing the current weather/environmental effects, statistics such as total Terminids squished and more 
- News and status updates, with notifications for live updates
- Check the current major order, and view the current progress
- Track the location of the DEMOCRACY SPACE STATION and view active effects 
- Widgets! Display current war stats right on your home screen! 
- The exciting STRATAGEM HERO mini-game, with high scores synced between Apple Watch and iPhone! (Now with sounds and custom loadouts!)
- Leaderboard rankings and Game Center integration for competitive play

Plus, get War Monitor on Apple Watch! Check the status of the war at a glance, and feel like a true Helldiver practicing stratagems right on your wrist!

Please note this is a continuous work in progress and might be prone to some pesky terminids!

Developed by James Poole.

Disclaimer: This app is independently created and is not officially affiliated with Arrowhead Game Studios or Sony. All game content and trademarks are the property of their respective owners.
en.releaseNotes: Improved loading with caching + bug fixes including a fix for the blank Player Count widget
en.subtitle: Featuring STRATAGEM HERO!

versionHistory.releaseNotes: Fixed missing planet images, and items missing from the armoury list.
Added the Illuminate to the bestiary, and new weapon images!

- Added support for iOS 18 Home Screen widget tinting
- Additional weather info added to planets

- Added videos for the new recently added Stratagems
- Small UI tweaks and new animations

Merry Christmas Helldivers!

Merry Christmas Helldivers!

This update adds 4 stratagems:
- W.A.S.P. Launcher
- Fast Recon Vehicle
- Anti-Tank Mines
- Gas Mines

Happy holidays!

Track the Democracy Space Station! See active tactical actions, such as the EAGLE STRIKE!

Also includes improvements to Major Orders, such as displaying multiple task types.
Fixed some bugs causing the DSS not to show any tactical action status

PERSONAL ORDERS are here! After much anticipation, divers can now track daily orders directly in the app!

Other changes:
- Added invasion levels and event HP tracking for Illuminate invasions
Fixed news timestamps!
Invasion levels show for all defense/invasion events

Configure the notifications YOU want to see! Choose between:
- Liberation updates
- News updates
- Defense/invasion events
...or pick all 3!

Other changes:
- Added a thumbnail for the Urban Legends Warbond

Points of interest and planet effects are here! Keep an eye on the path of the Meridian singularity with dynamically updating planet positions on the galaxy map! 

- Added gloom clouds to planets shrouded in the wall of gloom
- New icons to show different POIs on various planets
- A new pie chart to display the distribution of players across the galaxy (available for devices on iOS 17 or above)
- Planets are marked with a new symbol when they're part of a Major Order objective 
- Various UI tweaks
- The Super Store is no longer disabled when items aren't mapped, instead displaying a message from the Ministry of Truth to reduce confusion
- A new button when viewing a planet, to show you that planet's location on the map!
- Updated Super Earth faction icon
- watchOS 8 is unfortunately no longer supported
Track Dark Energy accumulation when viewing the Meridian black hole!
Illuminate fleet strength tracking and bug fixes!
Added partial support for the Battle for Super Earth!
Improved support for the Battle for Super Earth + bug fixes!

- Improved support for regional battles including Mega Cities in the Battle for Super Earth including enemy regen per hour 
- Additional Major Order mission extraction type support
- Bug fixes
Fixed a bug causing news feed widgets to be blank
Support for multiple Major Orders

Fixes a bug causing the War view to be blank
Fixes an issue causing the DSS to not show up
Improvements and bug fixes to Major Orders on iOS
Support for mega cities and regions on different planets!
Bugs fixed and terminids squashed - planet region statuses should display correctly again!
Early Sector location support for Extraction Major Orders
Updates for iOS 26 Liquid Glass, bug fixes, and improved networking
Improved loading with caching + bug fixes including a fix for the blank Player Count widget
